notes.title: Soulslayer Launchs on Nintendo Switch
notes.notes:
We just released Soulslayer on Nintendo Switch platform!

To celebrate the milestone and thank all the players who supporting us, we would like to start this promotion on Steam.

BTW, if you've purchased Soulslayer on Nintendo Switch US region with full price at the launch period (2019/09/26~2019/09/30), please contact us via info@nvlsoft.com. There was an accident about the discount setup and the price was not properly updated. We would like to make a compensation to those who supported us from the 1st day T_T

notes.title: Final Version of English Subtitles Released
notes.notes:
Merry christmas!

It's been a long time since we released the round one update.

During this time, BlueM1st and other team members polished the script for several rounds.

Now we have the final English version. You'll get it automatically by build 2381468.

Enjoy the holidays and sales ː12luckybellː

notes.title: Round One: English subtitles updated!
notes.notes:
Thanks to BlueM1st's hard work, we have a better English version.

It is not the final version though most lines are rewritten.

Please tell us how you feel about this game. We will always listen and keep improving.

Other updates:
· Improve the tone quality.
· Added freetalk section of "Yao Hongyuan".

Original Soundtrack Album is coming next week with 18 tracks.
We hope you will enjoy the game music.

Thank you very much for playing Slouslayer!ːssbowlː

notes.title: New English Version Coming Soon
notes.notes:
Thank you very much for playing this game!

We hope you like the art style which is a try of introducing traditional Chinese culture.

We've noticed that players mentioned issues in English translation. We are very sorry about that.

The game has been delayed for several months for the multi-language localization and we hired the best translation team within our budget. Unfortunately none of us are native speakers, there must be plenty of room for improvement.

We're working on it!

Now we have a native speaker helping us with the editing. We hope it will be getting better after several rounds of editing.

The first version with editing will be released later in next week. Then we will start next round next month.

Thanks again and be careful about the drinks ːssbowlː
